verdict.rationale: Bird & Bird's Tech and Digital Solutions page names specific AI tools used in client service: a Legora collaboration on a Generative AI legal assistant, Luminance for AI-assisted document review, and an 'Evaluate' tool that automates review of bidder responses. The firm also offers free client-facing automation products (SCC Generator, German Term Sheet Generator built on Contract Express), but these are document automation rather than AI. The AI disclosures are one-line capability blurbs, so they go only modestly beyond a marketing mention. Missing for 10: a published AI usage policy or governance statement, detailed documentation of how the Legora and Luminance tools are used in client matters, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, the firm publishes how it uses AI in client service — named tools, policies, or AI-practice products of its own — beyond a marketing mention

citations.quote: A collaboration with Legora to develop our Generative AI legal assistant to streamline and enhance legal workflows.
Using Luminance to combine the computing power of artificial intelligence with a hands-on review of documents
By automating the review and analysis of bidder responses, our outsourcing tool "Evaluate" does the heavy lifting for you.
